note: Dependency graph (not a serial chain). Requirements sit in the milestone where they first become testable. M15 is optional and must not block v1. See SPEC_AMENDMENTS.md AM-60.

milestones.title: Run leases, event journal and outbox
LangChain draft node and LangGraph workflow
Independent review, grant and outcome recovery

tasks.title: Reproduce reference baseline on this machine
tasks.instructions: In an isolated uv environment with the reference's web+test extras, run the 58-test suite and the recovery CLI on Windows. Record versions, results and any failures in reports/baseline/. Do not modify reference code.
definition_of_done: 58-test result and CLI output saved under reports/baseline/ with exact command and environment.
Any failure recorded verbatim; no test skipped or edited to pass.
STATUS.md states reference vs target capability honestly.

tasks.title: Inventory environment and probe qwen3:8b
tasks.instructions: Record hardware, Docker, Ollama and installed models. Run the AM-31 probe: >=30 schema-constrained calls with thinking disabled and explicit num_ctx; record JSON/schema validity, latency p50/p95, peak VRAM and model digest.
definition_of_done: reports/model-probe-qwen3-8b.md contains measured rates with denominators, parameters and digest.
Thinking-disabled behaviour verified, not assumed.
Owner decision raised if schema-valid rate < 90%.

tasks.title: Create uv workspace with per-service directories and locks
tasks.instructions: Implement ADR-0001 layout (core/, api/, worker/, mcp-server/, asset-sim/, incident-sim/). Resolve versions from official sources, commit uv.lock, add ruff, mypy and pytest wiring and a single `make check` / script entry point.
definition_of_done: `uv sync --locked` succeeds from a clean clone; lockfile committed.
ruff + mypy + pytest run green on the empty skeleton via one command.
Each service directory has README stating ownership and trust boundary.

tasks.title: Implement contracts, canonical bytes and state machine in core
tasks.instructions: Pydantic contracts from schemas with AM-14/AM-15 fixes and tool input schemas; canonical JSON v1; transition table incl. ESCALATED as data with one enforcing function; port the 58 reference behaviours as core tests.
definition_of_done: Property tests (Hypothesis) show canonical bytes stable and authority fields rejected.
Every allowed transition tested; every disallowed transition rejected.
Schema if/then rules reject model-asserted outcomes and envelope/data contradictions.
Reference behaviours re-expressed as core tests and passing.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL migrations, roles, RLS and security-definer functions
tasks.instructions: Alembic migrations for tenants, memberships, conversations, messages, runs (incl. next_event_seq), run_lease, jobs, events, outbox, proposals, decisions, execution_grant, action_attempt, idempotency. Roles migrator/api/worker/mcp_exec; RLS on api; checkpoints schema; resolve_invocation and grant_execution as SECURITY DEFINER.
definition_of_done: Migrations up/down on real PostgreSQL in tests.
Cross-tenant reads/child references fail as api role; pooled connections do not leak tenant.
mcp_exec SELECT on any table is permission denied; functions are its only access.

tasks.title: Independent incident-sim destination with atomic receipts and abort
tasks.instructions: Separate service + database: POST /internal/incidents (atomic incident+receipt, recomputed hash), GET /internal/actions/{id}, POST /internal/actions/{id}/abort tombstone; executor-audience auth; test-only fault hooks.
definition_of_done: Concurrent same-key submissions commit exactly one incident.
Same key + different bytes returns CONFLICT; caller-supplied hash ignored.
Abort tombstone blocks a late commit; worker/API tokens get 403.

tasks.title: Keycloak OIDC with backend sessions and current membership
tasks.instructions: Local Keycloak realm (5 personas, workload clients with audience mappers); authlib code+PKCE flow; opaque HttpOnly session, CSRF, origin checks; back-channel logout and periodic IdP status check; membership read from app tables.
definition_of_done: Negative tests: bad state/nonce/aud/iss, missing CSRF, revoked membership, disabled IdP user -> 401/403.
No tokens in URLs, browser storage or logs (asserted).
Realm export committed without secrets; dev secrets generated locally.

tasks.title: Versioned durable admission API
tasks.instructions: /api/v1 conversations, messages, runs; admission commits message+run+job+event in one transaction before 202; scoped Idempotency-Key (24 h window); one active run per conversation; relative interval resolved once with DB now().
definition_of_done: Fault test: crash before commit leaves no ack; after commit job exists.
Same key/same body replays result; different body 409.
Second active run in a conversation is refused.

tasks.title: Run-level lease, fence and independent heartbeat
tasks.instructions: run_lease acquisition with fence increment; all run mutations fence-checked; heartbeat as independent task; on lease loss cancel model/tool calls and revoke handles; model_permit semaphore; sweeper reclaims expired leases.
definition_of_done: Two workers racing one run: only the current fence writes (resume job vs original job case included).
Slow fake drafter (>30 s) keeps lease via heartbeat; forced heartbeat failure cancels it.
Human waits hold no lease or transaction.

tasks.title: Gap-free event journal, wake-ups and outbox
tasks.instructions: Per-run sequence from runs.next_event_seq under row lock; decision/reply wake-up jobs committed atomically; sweeper re-enqueues lost wake-ups; transactional outbox with leased delivery loop (no external channel).
definition_of_done: Concurrent event writers produce gap-free, commit-ordered sequences.
Crash between decision commit and processing is recovered by the sweeper.
Outbox rows deduplicated and leased; delivery result recorded separately.

tasks.title: Authenticated MCP server/client and invocation handles
tasks.instructions: mcp-server on official SDK 2.x over Streamable HTTP pinned to protocol 2026-07-28; workload token audience ops-mcp; X-Ops-Invocation handle bound to run fence; allowlist derived server-side via resolve_invocation; independent-process client tests.
definition_of_done: Real network client lists/calls tools from a separate process.
Wrong/missing aud, browser token, replayed/expired/other-run handle all rejected.
Worker-written allowlist cannot enable create_incident for a retrieval job.

tasks.title: Read tools, asset-sim and reconciliation-only receipt lookup
tasks.instructions: asset-sim service; get_asset_status, get_recent_alerts (absolute interval, next_cursor), search_procedures stub over governed store; get_incident_receipt for reconciliation workload only; fail-closed result validation.
definition_of_done: Cross-tenant asset reads denied; unexpected tools and malformed results fail closed.
Receipt lookup unavailable to normal/model workloads and cannot create actions.

tasks.title: Expanded corpus, governed ingestion and lexical baseline
tasks.instructions: Author >=12 documents (300-900 words), >=6 assets, 2 tenants, incl. superseded, conflicting and injected-instruction sources; per-section IDs and hashes; idempotent ingestion; PostgreSQL full-text retrieval with access filtering.
definition_of_done: Corpus and catalog committed with per-section sha256; ingestion idempotent.
Superseded/expired/revoked sections never returned.
Lexical retrieval measured on labelled dev queries (with denominators).

tasks.title: Exact pgvector retrieval and comparison
tasks.instructions: nomic-embed-text embeddings (record model, dimension, digest); exact search with the same access filters; comparison report against lexical on the same dev queries.
definition_of_done: reports/retrieval-comparison.md with recall@k for both methods, denominators and CIs.
Access filters applied before scores; no cross-tenant results.

tasks.title: LangChain ChatOllama DraftGenerator
tasks.instructions: Versioned prompts; ChatOllama with thinking disabled, num_ctx 16384, num_predict 1000, 60 s timeout; structural validation incl. citation membership; one bounded repair; explicit MODEL_MODE fake|ollama with no fallback.
definition_of_done: Recorded real-model run evidence (model digest, params, outputs).
Injected-instruction source cannot add tools/authority; invalid output -> bounded repair -> controlled failure.
Missing model fails clearly; fake mode labelled in every output.

tasks.title: Explicit LangGraph workflow with durable pauses
tasks.instructions: Nodes per BUILD_SPEC section 8 with retrieval before drafting; deterministic edges; clarification and approval interrupts carrying IDs/hashes only; nodes reread authoritative state; checkpoints in checkpoints schema.
definition_of_done: Trace shows MCP reads complete before the draft node.
Pause/resume survives worker process restart.
Checkpoint blobs contain no evidence or proposal text (grep test).

tasks.title: Immutable proposals, independent decisions and final grant
tasks.instructions: Per-revision proposal IDs; decision endpoint with expected hash; first decision wins; author-set independence; lazy+scheduled expiry to BLOCKED_REVIEW; grant_execution final gate with one active grant per run and proposal/run binding.
definition_of_done: Self-approval and reviewer-authored-revision approval denied.
Opposing/stale decisions 409; expired proposal blocked.
Revocation or cancellation before grant blocks dispatch; second grant for a run impossible.
Cross-run proposal_id with valid handle writes nothing.

tasks.title: Execution, crash-window recovery and escalation
tasks.instructions: action_attempt INTENT/SENT/RESOLVED; recovery for windows a-d; same-key redispatch or abort per AM-13; bounded reconciliation backoff; CONFLICT and expired unknown -> ESCALATED; receipt retention.
definition_of_done: Kill tests at each of windows a, b, c, d end with exactly one matching incident or an authoritative abort.
Missing receipt never becomes FAILED without tombstone/rejection.
Hash conflict escalates; never success.

tasks.title: Executable deterministic scenario suite
tasks.instructions: Convert the 32 development scenario cards into pytest scenarios with oracles asserting final application and destination state; run on every PR.
definition_of_done: All 32 cards executable; oracle failures point to state, not prose.
Suite runs in under 10 minutes in fake model mode.

tasks.title: Model-quality evaluation with owner-authored holdout
tasks.instructions: ~60 dev cases; ~25 owner-authored holdout cases kept outside the repo with committed sha256; quality-gates.json committed before first holdout run; 3 isolated trials; conditions manual/RAG/orchestrated; Wilson 95% CIs.
definition_of_done: reports/eval/ contains per-condition rates with denominators and CIs.
Holdout hash and gates commit predate the holdout run (git history).
Unset gates or any unauthorized write blocks release.

tasks.title: React workspace: conversation, evidence and approvals
tasks.instructions: Vite + React + TS; three panels; the eight AM-40 states; escaped/approved markdown; authorized evidence viewer; approval card bound to revision/hash; manual proposal path.
definition_of_done: Playwright: requester flow, independent reviewer approval, stale card disabled.
Malicious content does not execute; keyboard-only approval works.

tasks.title: Authenticated SSE replay and revocation
tasks.instructions: Last-Event-ID replay from gap-free sequences; heartbeat; cursor reset snapshot; access recheck on every frame; identity change closes stream.
definition_of_done: Reconnect replays without duplicates or gaps.
Revoked membership/source stops the stream and redacts evidence.

tasks.title: OpenTelemetry tracing with redaction
tasks.instructions: OTel SDK in api/worker/mcp-server; collector + one trace backend; bounded metric labels; redaction tests for tokens, handles and evidence text.
definition_of_done: One run correlated across api, worker, mcp-server and incident-sim in a saved trace.
Secret-bearing fields absent from exported telemetry (asserted).

tasks.title: Budgets and degraded operation
tasks.instructions: Queue/model/time/retry caps from BUILD_SPEC section 17; dependency outage behaviour with templated messages; capacity measurement on the owner's hardware.
definition_of_done: Ollama/MCP/destination outages produce truthful states.
reports/capacity.md with measured limits on named hardware.

tasks.title: Hardened images, Compose profiles and network isolation
tasks.instructions: Multi-stage non-root images from uv.lock; compose profiles (test, demo); docker networks enforce model-to-destination and browser-to-internal denial; test-only fault factory; docker-kill worker recovery demo.
definition_of_done: `docker compose --profile demo up` reaches healthy; images scanned with results saved.
Denied network paths tested from containers.
Killing a worker around destination commit yields one incident (recorded).

tasks.title: GitHub Actions CI with trust separation
tasks.instructions: PR workflow: ruff, mypy, unit, PostgreSQL integration, scenario suite, image build+scan; pinned action SHAs; least-privilege tokens; no secrets on PRs.
definition_of_done: CI green on the public repo for a real PR.
Workflow review shows pinned SHAs and no privileged PR context.

tasks.title: Retained-receipt restore demonstration
tasks.instructions: Restore an older app backup against the retained destination; reconcile by original action IDs; runbook with exact commands and observations.
definition_of_done: Recorded restore run ending with matching incident and no duplicate.
docs/runbooks/restore.md with real observations.

tasks.title: Clean-machine reproduction and three recorded demos
tasks.instructions: From a clean clone: setup, success demo, denial demo, recovery demo; deterministic mode shown separately.
definition_of_done: Recorded demos and setup transcript saved under reports/demos/.
Every README claim links to evidence.

tasks.title: Release notes, MIT license and publication
tasks.instructions: README rewrite for interviewers, ADR index, limitations (single-writer checkpoints, solo holdout), MIT LICENSE, push to github.com/jschnepel/MLOps.
definition_of_done: Claim-to-evidence map complete; limitations stated.
Owner approves the push.

tasks.title: kind/Helm deployment with default CNI policy tests
tasks.instructions: Helm chart and kind cluster using kind's default CNI with kube-network-policies; pod-level allow/deny and pod-kill tests.
definition_of_done: Actual NetworkPolicy denials observed from pods.

tasks.title: Paused-version upgrade and rollback rehearsal
tasks.instructions: Route paused v1 runs to compatible code across a workflow_version bump; rollback test.
definition_of_done: Paused run resumes correctly after upgrade and after rollback.

tasks.title: SBOM and release provenance
tasks.instructions: Generate SBOM and provenance attestations for released images; link to tested inputs.
definition_of_done: Released artifacts verifiably link to commit, lock and test evidence.

tasks.title: Fenced distributed checkpoint writes
tasks.instructions: BaseCheckpointSaver subclass that checks run fence inside each put/put_writes transaction; stale-worker head-hijack test.
definition_of_done: Paused old worker resumed after lease loss cannot append a checkpoint.

tasks.title: Opt-in Slack adapter
tasks.instructions: Verified callbacks, identity mapping, outbox delivery, same review/execute policy.
definition_of_done: Owner-approved workspace; replayed callbacks deduplicated.

tasks.title: Approved budgeted cloud deployment
tasks.instructions: Terraform/EKS only after owner cost and teardown approval.
definition_of_done: Approved budget, applied and torn down with evidence.
